title: An Unexpected Encounter with a Surprising Stranger
coreMove: Hidden mentors are found through receptivity: listen for wisdom before status instincts decide who is worth learning from.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a useful warning can be missed when status decides who gets heard
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the homeless-looking stranger as a receptivity test
Use the billionaire reveal begins as a clue-reading exercise
Make wealth and credentials irrelevant as first filters

exampleSpecs.stakes: comfort can become a filter that rejects needed disruption
class reflexes can prevent genuine attention
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Confront reflexive class and status judgments

exampleSpecs.stakes: cynicism can keep a wounded gift away from help
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the artist's skepticism as the barrier
